answer: Unclear. The dataset contains no customer age or demographic split, so you cannot conclude this is ‘just a habit of older customers.’ Multiple distinct complaints and the luggage‑capacity study (mean 7.1) point to genuine problems with boot volume, tailgate reliability and fittings; conversely some feedback says the boot size is acceptable for them. We need demographic‑segmented data before attributing the issue to age.
suggested_change: Require the ingress/egress study to record participant ages (and other demographics) and report results by age group. Either require the ≥90% 'easy' threshold per major age segment or mandate a study sample representative of the customer age distribution.
